title: Uniform influence bound for polynomial thresholds
statement: There is a constant $C\ge 0$ such that, for every natural number $k$, every natural number $n$, and every Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube that is a polynomial threshold function of degree at most $k$, the total influence of its associated real-valued function is at most $Ck\sqrt n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
